title: Phase and group velocity of deep-water waves
caption: For ω = √(gk) the phase velocity is √(g/k) and the group velocity is half of it, whatever the wavenumber: the crests overtake the group.
alt: Two falling curves of speed against wavenumber k, the phase velocity above and the group velocity exactly half as high.
description: The phase velocity v_p = ω/k = √(g/k) falls as k grows.
The group velocity v_g = dω/dk = ½√(g/k) is half of it at every k.
At k = 1 rad/m with g = 9.81 m/s² the phase velocity is 3.13 m/s and the group velocity 1.57 m/s.

checks.name: the phase velocity exceeds the group velocity
